feeds.title: American Childhood Cancer Organization Blog
feeds.description: Educational resources to children with cancer, survivors, and their families. ACCO is the oldest and largest grassroots childhood cancer organization in the U.S. dedicated to making childhood cancer a national health priority.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Research Fund Blog
feeds.description: Children's Cancer Research Fund invests in lifesaving, leading-edge research in the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure of childhood cancers and blood-related disorders.

feeds.title: CURE Childhood Cancer Blog
feeds.description: CURE Childhood Cancer is dedicated to conquering childhood cancer through funding targeted research and through support of patients and their families.

feeds.title: Emily Whitehead Foundation News
feeds.description: Find news, events and updates on how the Emily Whitehead Foundation is activating the cure for childhood cancer. The Emily Whitehead Foundation is non-profit organization committed to raising funds to invest in the most promising pediatric cancer research, providing financial support to pediatric cancer patients, and raising awareness through education and sharing inspiring stories.

feeds.title: CureSearch Blog
feeds.description: The CureSearch blog is about children's cancer survivors, fighters and supporters, and the cancer research that accelerates the search for cures.

feeds.title: Childhood Cancer Foundation South Africa
feeds.description: CHOC is a non-profit organization made up of caring, committed and passionate people who stand up for and support the well-being of children and teenagers diagnosed with cancer or life-threatening blood disorders and their families.

feeds.title: C17 Council Blog
feeds.description: News & Updates from C17 Council-Childrens Cancer & Blood Disorders. Their goal is to improve outcomes and quality of life for children and adolescents with cancer and serious blood disorders in Canada.

feeds.title: Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario (POGO) Blog
feeds.description: At POGO (Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario) we give kids with cancer and their families the support they need - not just during the difficult time around therapy, but for years after - when they can face complications from the very treatments that saved their lives.

feeds.title: The Gold Hope Project Blog
feeds.description: The Gold Hope Project provides free portrait sessions for pediatric cancer patients to bring awareness to childhood cancer and provide funding for a cure.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Cause Blog
feeds.description: Children's Cancer Cause is the leading national advocacy organization working to achieve access to less toxic and more effective pediatric cancer therapies; to expand resources for research and specialized care, and to address the unique needs and challenges of childhood cancer survivors and their families. Read the Children's Cancer Cause blog for the latest information in childhood cancer legislation, research, events, resources, and more.

feeds.title: Little Fighters Cancer Trust Blog
feeds.description: The Little Fighters Cancer Trust strives to relieve some of the heartache and difficulties faced by Childhood Cancer affected families. On their blog they share tips for parents to deal with the changes in their child's body caused due to cancer.

feeds.title: Childhood Eye Cancer Trust Blog
feeds.description: Retinoblastoma news, research updates, and real life stories. The Childhood Eye Cancer Trust is a UK charity dedicated to helping people affected by retinoblastoma, a rare form of eye cancer. Their mission is to support people affected by retinoblastoma and to raise awareness of the signs and symptoms of the condition.

feeds.title: Dominic's journey with AML
feeds.description: Our son Dominic was admitted to Alberta Children's Hospital Sept. 12, 2013, diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia. He died Sept. 3, 2015. This blog tracks his journey and ours.

feeds.title: Isabella Santos Foundation
feeds.description: The Isabella Santos Foundation is a kids foundation for children with cancer. As a pediatric cancer foundation, they aim to spread awareness. Their mission is to raise money and awareness for Neuroblastoma Research in the hopes of one day finding a cure.

feeds.title: mbcandlelighters Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to offer emotional support to parents and their families who are experiencing or have experienced the effects of childhood cancer. We will achieve this by lending an empathetic ear, sharing the effects of cancer life, and offer a heartfelt sincere presence to help families cope, and help parents help their children.

feeds.title: Cure4TheKids Blog
feeds.description: Cure 4 The Kids Foundation is a nonprofit organization treating & preventing childhood catastrophic diseases, cancer & blood disorders.

feeds.title: Steven Battles Cancer
feeds.description: Steven was nine years old when he was diagnosed with osteosarcoma in February 2011. His knee was amputated in a procedure known as Van Ness Rotationplasty. He is determined to beat cancer.

feeds.title: Rally Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Rally Foundation for Childhood Cancer Research, a non-profit organization, empowers volunteers across the country to raise awareness and funds for childhood cancer research to find better treatments with fewer long-term side effects and, ultimately, cures.

feeds.title: Superman Sam
feeds.description: Sam was diagnosed with AML in June of 2012, and relapsed in April of 2013. His bone marrow transplant was in August of 2013, but he relapsed again in November and died in December, 2013.We miss him every day. This blog is called Superman Sam not because he loved Superman, but because he was OUR superman.

feeds.title: Children with Cancer UK Blogs
feeds.description: Children with Cancer UK is the leading national children's charity dedicated to the fight against childhood cancer. Here patient families and young people with cancer share their blogs with us and hope to inspire people to contribute to a better future for our children.

feeds.title: National Pediatric Cancer Foundation News
feeds.description: The National Pediatric Cancer Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to funding research to eliminate childhood cancer. Our focus is to fund research to find less toxic, more targeted therapies by partnering with leading hospitals nationwide.

feeds.title: Treehouse Childhood Cancer Initiative Blog
feeds.description: The UC Santa Cruz Treehouse Childhood Cancer Initative enables sharing of pediatric cancer genomic data. But more than that, it makes it possible to analyze a child's cancer data against both childhood and adult patient cohorts across all types of cancer.

feeds.title: Help In the Nick of Time - Speakers Corner
feeds.description: Help in the Nick of Time is a charity set up in the memory of our son Nick who loved sports and helping people. The goal of the organization is to work through local charity organizations to direct assistance to single parent families facing short term needs to help them get back on their feet.

feeds.title: The Peter Powerhouse Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Peter Powerhouse Foundation is improving the lives of children during cancer treatment, helping survivors to thrive. Their mission is to improve the lives of childhood cancer patients by providing donations to the facilities that treat them and to provide grants to researchers that will improve the lives of the childhood cancer survivor.

feeds.title: Unravel Pediatric Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Unravel is a non-profit organization working to spread knowledge about the grim realities of pediatric cancer and the devastating impact from the lack of funding. They supply the information, tools and support to individuals and communities that want to help create change because, good people want to do good things but sometimes they need help getting started.

feeds.title: BraveHearts for Kids Blog
feeds.description: BraveHearts for Kids was makes a life and death difference for children diagnosed with cancer. Our mission is to provide life-saving hope and inspiration to families facing a pediatric cancer ordeal through outreach, information and mentoring.

feeds.title: New Mom ..... New Cancer
feeds.description: My name is Kezia and my daughter, Saoirse, and I battled two different types of cancer. I was diagnosed with Stage 3, Hodgkin's Lymphoma at the end of January, 2011. I started my chemotherapy at the beginning of February. Saoirse was diagnosed with Stage 4, nMYC amplified, Neuroblastoma at the beginning of May 2011, and began chemotherapy immediately.

feeds.title: Forgive the Snark
feeds.description: Ann Ramer of the RamerNation, where topics such as childhood cancer, Li Fraumeni, osteosarcoma, caringbridge, patient advocacy will be discussed.

feeds.title: Shane's Future Days Blog
feeds.description: Shane's Future Days is a non-profit foundation located in the Philadelphia area whose mission is to raise awareness, research funds and assist families currently battling Alveolar Rhabdomyosarcoma and other rare childhood cancers.

feeds.title: Life Love and Little Things
feeds.description: A website not only about our life in remission and the things we love, but also about the little things that people do that can make a big difference. You will find blogs on our experience with childhood cancer and our life in remission. You will also find information and support, should you need it.

feeds.title: KatyDid Cancer
feeds.description: A blog about being a young breast cancer survivor. Musings on life, chemo, being bald, taking care of small kids and trying to work through treatment.

feeds.title: The Matthews Story
feeds.description: A story of neuroblastoma, premature birth, loss, and adoption.

feeds.title: Cole Baker will Kick Cancer's Ass
feeds.description: A blog about neuroblastoma childhood cancer.

feeds.title: Team Ellie
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ellie and I'm 14 years old. In September 2015 I got diagnosed with a rare childhood cancer called Alveolar Rhabdomyosarcoma. It totally flipped my life upside down but now I can use all the horrible experiences I had to inspire and advise you guys.

feeds.title: OAK's Camp Reach for the Sky FLASHLIGHT
feeds.description: Camp Reach for the Sky has been a highly successful program serving pediatric cancer patients and their siblings ages 4-18 for more than 20 years.

feeds.title: Katie Clark--The Ramblings Of A Cancer Kid Mom...And A Grieving Heart
feeds.description: A blog about childhood cancer authored by Katie Clark.

feeds.title: C is for Crocodile
feeds.description: Caemon is a little boy who was diagnosed with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) just before his third birthday. After several rounds of chemotherapy and finally a bone marrow transplant, Caemon lost his battle with leukemia on February 5, 2013. Read Caemon's story on our blog.

feeds.title: Keepin' Georgia on Your Mind
feeds.description: I'm 17 and I love to read! My mom and I started this blog to share the details of my victory over Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

feeds.title: Beauty From The Ashes Blog
feeds.description: Katie Caldwell-Burchett is a wife and mother of 3 who has experienced unimaginable tragedy. Her daughter Olivia, was diagnosed with an aggressive form of brain cancer at just 4 months old. She watched her daughter fight fearlessly for 16 months before the cancer stole her life. However, the loss of her daughter was only the beginning. She hopes that in sharing her story she can inspire others to know that there is life after loss. And sometimes that life can turn into a beautiful thing. There is beauty after all that can come from the ashes of a life that comes down in flames.

feeds.title: You Get What You Get
feeds.description: Read the childhood cancer journey story authored by Abbi Perets.

feeds.title: Christian's Fight
feeds.description: This is the ongoing story of our five year old son's battle with stage 3 Rhabdomyosarcoma in his abdomen. He recently earned his wings and entered the kingdom of heaven. He is full and surrounded by God's glory. He is our little hero and an amazing example of the adversity that children can overcome. God is our Healer, now that medicine is done, GOD will begin. All the glory belongs to him.

feeds.title: Pediatric Retinoblastoma Blog
feeds.description: Pediatric retinoblastoma is a life-threatening type of kids eye cancer. Learn about the condition and pediatric retinoblastoma attorneys.

feeds.title: For the love of Ava & God's glory
feeds.description: Welcome to Ava's blog. Ava (5 years old) was admitted to the hospital for persistent fevers and a skin infection that wouldn't heal. What was thought to be 'just a skin infection' revealed the shocking news that Ava had a rare form of leukemia. The purpose of this blog is to keep family and friends updated on her progress and communicate ways to help and support the Lee family.

feeds.title: Childhood Cancer Hall of Champions Blog
feeds.description: Michael is the Founder of Childhood Cancer Hall of Champions. For over two decades, he has been supporting organizations that advocate for children and families who are impacted by cancer. .

feeds.title: Our Little Hazelnut
feeds.description: Hazel was diagnosed in April 2013 with Stage 3 Neuroblastoma. She is suffering from childhood cancer. Please keep Hazel in your prayers, and all kids like her, so they can have a childhood free from cancer!

feeds.title: NEGU Blog
feeds.description: Jessie Rees Foundation is all about giving 'CARE' to each child and family. We will care until there is a cure. Help us care for and encourage every child. Ensuring every kid & family impacted by childhood cancer has the support & resources to Never Ever Give Up!

feeds.title: Childhood Cancer India
feeds.description: A personal insight into various issues relevant to children with cancer, their families and health professionals involved in their care in India.

feeds.title: B+ Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts cover childhood cancer research and funding, The B+ Foundation is a children's cancer charity that helps kids through financial assistance, research, and advocacy.

feeds.title: Cannonball Kids' Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Cannonball Kids' cancer is dedicated to funding innovative, accessible research to provide better treatments and quality of life for children fighting cancer, and educating for change.

feeds.title: ASK Childhood Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: ASK is a non-profit organization dedicated to making life better for children with cancer and their families in Central Virginia.

feeds.title: Families Fighting Childhood Cancer
feeds.description: Families Fighting Childhood Cancer is a support group provided by Oklahoma Family Network, that provides support for families who have children with special medical needs. All staff that works for Oklahoma Family Network has a child who has special medical needs or has lost a child.

feeds.title: Sears National Kids Cancer Ride
feeds.description: The Sears National Kids Cancer Ride is one of the biggest and most ambitious charity cycling events on behalf of childhood cancer in the world. Their vision is a world Beyond Kids Cancer.

feeds.title: Keira Kilbane Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Funding childhood cancer research, and providing financial support and encouragement to patients and families.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Recovery Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Children's Cancer Recovery Foundation delivers simple acts of care and kindness to children and their families experiencing cancer.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Institute News
feeds.description: Children's Cancer Institute is the only independent medical research institute in Australia wholly dedicated to putting an end to childhood cancer. Stay up to date with our blog on latest research news, meet our researchers and hear what's happening in our labs and beyond.
